newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-GRAF IN DEEP TROUBLE AS RAIN HALTS PLAY.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-GRAF IN DEEP TROUBLE AS RAIN HALTS PLAY.

text.p: Defending champion Steffi Graf was staring at a heavy defeat by South African Amanda Coetzer when rain stopped play in mid-afternoon at the French Open on Tuesday.

The German world number two was trailing Coetzer 6-1 3-1 when their match was halted, facing the prospect of her first defeat at Roland Garros since the 1994 semifinals when she was beaten by Mary Pierce.
Belgium's Filip Dewulf just had time before the rain arrived to become the first qualifier since John McEnroe 20 years ago to reach a grand slam semifinal.
Dewulf defeated Sweden's Magnus Norman 6-2 6-7 6-4 6-3 on Centre Court, wrapping up victory in pouring rain after two hours 43 minutes.
